title: Case 4: The 3 AM Spike
story: Latency spiked at 03:00. One host in the load balancer log returned errors far more than the rest.
goal: Find the backend with the most 500 errors in /case/lb.log.

files./case/lb.log:
03:00 backend-a 200
03:00 backend-b 500
03:01 backend-b 500
03:01 backend-c 200
03:02 backend-b 500
03:02 backend-a 500
03:03 backend-c 200

hints: Keep only the 500 lines, then count by host.

Run:
grep ' 500' /case/lb.log | cut -d' ' -f2 | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn
Then answer: backend-b
socratic: Which file is the oldest witness?
Do two files tell different stories?
Which command shows you the evidence you need?
explain: In one sentence: what was the cause, and how did you fix it?
